title: The Last Reservation
description: Celebrity food critic Kabir Sen dies suddenly during the dessert course at Le Miroir. Trace the poisoned wine batch and kitchen access logs.

assets.altText: Private dining table with half-eaten dessert, decanted wine bottle, and forensic evidence tags
Recording of the private reservation call made to the restaurant matre d'

sections.title: Section 1: The Last Course
sections.narrative: At 9:45 PM, critic Kabir Sen collapsed while finishing his five-course tasting menu. The digital kitchen ticket indicates a non-standard order modification entered just before plating.

questions.prompt: What seven-letter dessert course was specially sent to Kabir's private booth: 'HAZELNUT _______'?

hints.hintText: A delicate baked French egg dessert that collapses if left standing.

sections.title: Section 2: The Wine Bottle
sections.narrative: The sommelier served a 2018 Saint-milion vintage. The cork was found with microscopic syringe puncture marks along the foil seal.

questions.prompt: Decipher the cellar inventory bin code written on the tampered vintage bottle: 'ROTATE NUMBERS: 9-0-4' -> 'FOUR-ZERO-NINE'

hints.hintText: Read the three digits in reverse order.

sections.title: Section 3: The Allergy Note
sections.narrative: The guest registry records an explicit medical advisory for Kabir Sen regarding lethal almond extract cross-contamination.

questions.prompt: True or False: The victim's severe cyanide-like amygdalin allergy was officially logged in the head chef's dietary ledger.

hints.hintText: Inspect the red highlighted warning on the server station clipboard.

sections.title: Section 4: The Surveillance Reel
sections.narrative: Kitchen surveillance covers the pastry preparation station and sommelier lockup during dinner service.

questions.prompt: Which staff member accessed the sommelier reserve station unaccompanied right before the dessert course was dispatched?

hints.hintText: The chef wearing the black apron who prepared the souffl garnish.

sections.title: Section 5: The Voicemail
sections.narrative: A wiretapped phone message left for the restaurant manager prior to opening explains why the critic was targeted.

questions.prompt: Listen to the recorded reservation tape. What career-ending rating does the caller mention Kabir was preparing to publish tomorrow?

metadata.transcript: Sen is coming tonight. If his review runs tomorrow, our Michelin star is revoked and the restaurant is finished. He gave us zero stars in his draft.

hints.hintText: The absolute lowest rating possible in culinary reviews.

clues.title: Allergy Medical Advisory
clues.clueText: Kabir Sen had a documented deadly allergy to almond extracts, known to every senior chef.

clues.title: Zero-Star Panic Recording
clues.clueText: Management discovered Kabir was publishing a devastating zero-star review that would bankrupt the venue.

clues.title: Tampered Wine Bin 409
clues.clueText: A syringe needle hole was discovered in the foil seal of the wine bottle from Bin 409.

clues.title: Pastry Station Access Still
clues.clueText: Vivek Mehra was recorded entering the wine prep alcove alone immediately prior to dessert plating.

clues.title: Modified Dessert Order Ticket
clues.clueText: The digital ticket confirmed Vivek added pure bitter almond extract to Kabir's personal souffl.
